s: Which one of the following correctly represents the goalposts used for mean years of schooling and expected years of schooling in HDI calculation?

s: If the actual value of an HDI indicator is 50, with a minimum goalpost of 20 and a maximum goalpost of 80, the dimension index will be:
x: The dimension index is calculated as (actual value − minimum value)/(maximum value − minimum value), which is (50−20)/(80−20) = 0.50.
tq: Apply the normalized-index formula rather than recalling the formula mechanically.

s: Why is income entered as a logarithm in the calculation of the Human Development Index?
o: Because income is measured only in nominal dollars
Because the importance of additional income declines as income rises
To give greater weight to very high incomes
To exclude purchasing power parity from the calculation
x: The logarithmic transformation reflects diminishing returns: additional income contributes progressively less to human development as income rises.
tq: Identify the stated cause behind a methodological choice.
sec: HDI dimensions and indicators - included and excluded, goalposts, calculation

s: The $75,000 cap in the income dimension of the HDI primarily prevents:
o: Low-income countries from being included in the index
Education indicators from entering the index
Very high incomes from dominating the index
Purchasing power parity from affecting income values
x: The income cap prevents exceptionally high incomes from disproportionately influencing the overall HDI.
tq: Link a numerical ceiling with its stated purpose.

s: Which one of the following statements regarding the construction of the HDI is correct?

The HDI is the arithmetic mean of the three dimension indices.
The HDI is based only on the income and health indices.
The HDI uses the literacy rate instead of years of schooling after 2010.
x: The HDI is calculated as the geometric mean of the three dimension indices. The geometric mean replaced the arithmetic mean in 2010.

s:

x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because literacy and gross enrolment were replaced by mean years of schooling and expected years of schooling in 2010.
tq: Find the one statement that reverses a documented methodological change.
